stem: Water, sugar, and other important nutrients need to be transported from one part of a plant to another. Which statement correctly describes the interaction of the root and shoot systems during nutrient transport?

options.label: A
options.text: The leaves take in water and sugar, which are then transported to the rest of the plant through vascular tissues.

options.label: B
options.text: The roots take in water and sugar, which are then transported to the rest of the plant through vascular tissues.

options.label: C
options.text: The leaves take in water and the roots produce sugar that are transported to the rest of the plant through vascular tissues.

options.label: D
options.text: The roots take in water and the leaves produce sugar that are transported to the rest of the plant through vascular tissues.
